info.name: Setu Payment Reconciliation — end-to-end demo
info.description: Run the entire collection in order. Request 02 creates fresh IDs for each run; the remaining requests reuse them. Set baseUrl and apiKey. Requires no seed data. Does not delete any records. A seeded service can be explored separately with the README filters.

item.name: 05 List with merchant, status, dates, sorting and pagination

exec: pm.test('SQL filters and pagination', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(function (r) { return r.transaction_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('tx'); })).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Pending settlement is discrepant after grace', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); const row = pm.response.json().data.find(function (r) { return r.transaction_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('tx'); }); pm.expect(Boolean(row)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(row.reasons).to.include('processed_not_settled'); });

pm.test('Settled with three unique events, not four deliveries', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('settled'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().event_count).to.eql(3); pm.expect(pm.response.json().events.length).to.eql(3); });

item.name: 09 Reconciliation summary by merchant, date, status

exec: pm.test('Currency-safe SQL summary', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().group_by).to.include('currency'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(function (r) { return r.status === 'settled' && r.currency === 'INR'; })).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 10 Reused event ID with changed amount is rejected

exec: pm.test('409 is retained in audit without overwriting the payment', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('idempotency_key_reuse'); });
pm.test('Contradictory evidence accepted for investigation', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(201); });

pm.test('Conflict is visible to operations', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); const row = pm.response.json().data.find(function (r) { return r.transaction_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('tx'); }); pm.expect(Boolean(row)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(row.status).to.eql('conflicted'); pm.expect(row.reasons).to.include('settled_failed_payment'); pm.expect(row.reasons).to.include('ingestion_conflict'); });
pm.test('422 for invalid money precision', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(422); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('validation_error'); });

pm.test('Append-only event and rejected-payload audit', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().amount).to.eql('100.25'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().event_count).to.eql(4); pm.expect(pm.response.json().conflict_count).to.eql(1); pm.expect(pm.response.json().conflicts[0].reason).to.eql('idempotency_key_reuse'); });
